description: Defines an abstract class 'NotesLocalDataSource' specifying methods for local storage operations related to notes, such as CRUD, synchronization timestamps, and metadata management.

classes.name: NotesLocalDataSource
classes.description: An abstract class providing the interface for local data operations related to notes, including CRUD, deletion, transaction, and synchronization timestamp management.

methods.name: upsertNote
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a note in the local store.

methods.name: upsertNotesInTransaction
methods.description: Inserts or replaces multiple notes atomically.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID, or null if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: getAllNonDeletedSorted
methods.description: Returns all notes that are not marked as deleted, sorted by updatedAt descending.

methods.name: getAllIncludingDeleted
methods.description: Returns all notes, including those marked as deleted, sorted by updatedAt descending.

methods.name: getDirtyNotes
methods.description: Returns all notes that are marked as dirty, including tombstones.

methods.name: markDeleted
methods.description: Marks a note as deleted and dirty, updating its updatedAt timestamp.

methods.name: markClean
methods.description: Marks the provided list of notes as clean (not dirty).

methods.name: purgeDeleted
methods.description: Removes notes that are marked as deleted and already synchronized (clean).

methods.name: getLastSyncAt
methods.description: Gets the last synchronization timestamp for a given key.

methods.name: setLastSyncAt
methods.description: Sets the last synchronization timestamp for a given key.
